metadata.description: Every Claude Code skill this account uses, installable on any machine with one marketplace add.

plugins.name: video-use
plugins.description: Edit video by conversation. Transcribes with word-level timestamps and speaker diarization, cuts on speech boundaries and silence gaps, colour grades, burns subtitles, and generates overlay animations. Also bundles the manim-video animation skill. Needs ffmpeg and an ElevenLabs API key.

plugins.name: design-dna
plugins.description: Extract, define, and apply design DNA across three dimensions: design system tokens, qualitative style, and visual effects (Canvas, WebGL, 3D, particles, shaders, scroll). Turns reference screenshots into a machine-readable design profile, then generates from it.

plugins.name: gsap-skills
plugins.description: Official GSAP skills: core tween API, timelines, ScrollTrigger, plugins, utilities, React, non-React frameworks, and performance. Referenced upstream, not copied.

plugins.name: superseo
plugins.description: 11 SEO skills: page audits, content briefs, article writing with anti-AI-slop rules, E-E-A-T audits, semantic gap analysis, topic clusters, featured snippet optimization, link building, and expert interviews. Referenced upstream, not copied.
